1/1: Based on the screenshots and the code, what’s happening is: 1. In your Quarto → Confluence override (overrides.lua), all links are being rendered as `January` i.e. with single‐quoted href attributes. 2. In the Confluence publisher (confluence-helper.ts) you only look for `href="…"` (double quotes) when you do `.replaceAll(LINK_FINDER, replacer)` so none of those single‐quoted anchors ever get picked up or rewritten into Confluence page URLs. 3. Confluence then sees an `` with a relative, single‐quoted href that it doesn’t know how to resolve, strips it, and you end up with plain text. The simplest fix is to make your LinkConfluence override emit double-quoted href attributes. That way the existing LINK_FINDER regex will match and your publisher will replace those with proper Confluence page links. ```lua ### src/resources/extensions/quarto/confluence/overrides.lua <<<<<<< SEARCH function LinkConfluence(source, target, title, attr) -- For some reason, rendering converts spaces to a double line-break source = string.gsub(source, "\\n\\n", " ") source = string.gsub(source, "\\n\xa0\\n", " ") source = string.gsub(source, "(\\n", "") source = string.gsub(source, "\\n)", "") return "" .. source .. "" end ======= function LinkConfluence(source, target, title, attr) -- For some reason, rendering converts spaces to a double line-break source = string.gsub(source, "\\n\\n", " ") source = string.gsub(source, "\\n\xa0\\n", " ") source = string.gsub(source, "(\\n", "") source = string.gsub(source, "\\n)", "") -- switch to double quotes so confluence-helper.ts’s LINK_FINDER will pick it up return "" .. source ..
